description: Global Electricity Reliability Dataset (1km, 2012-2022) from NASA Black Marble Nighttime Lights, published by Srija Chakraborty, estimates spatial electricity reliability from NASA Black Marble nighttime lights. Coverage: Global 1 km estimates for 2012-2022. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: Nighttime light-derived reliability is an inferred proxy, not a direct outage-meter record. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support resilience, hazard exposure studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: data-nasa-black-marble-night-lights covers the upstream radiance products, not this derived electricity-access or reliability layer.
